categories.question: You have news you've been waiting months to share. How do you tell your favourite person?

outcomes.name: Call from the pavement
outcomes.description: An excited adult holding their phone to their ear on a patch of city pavement

outcomes.name: Wait until dinner
outcomes.description: Two adults leaning across a dinner table smiling over candles

outcomes.name: Slip a note into their bag
outcomes.description: An adult tucking a folded handwritten card into an open tote

outcomes.name: Show them the envelope
outcomes.description: Two adults grinning together over an opened official-looking envelope with no readable text
